tasks.title: Debounce _persist() calls in Zustand store
tasks.description: Every state action in kanban.ts fires _persist() immediately (lines ~209, 219, 236…). On rapid interactions (drag, typing) this triggers dozens of IPC save calls per second. Wrap _persist() with a debounce (e.g. 300 ms) so only the final state in a burst is written to disk.

tasks.title: Memoize computed arrays in Board.tsx
tasks.description: visibleColumns and hiddenColumns (lines ~58-62) are re-sorted/filtered on every render, including every pixel of a drag event. columnTasks inside handleDragOver is also recomputed on each dragover. Wrap these with useMemo / move them out of the event handler so the sort only runs when the underlying data changes.

tasks.title: Replace O(n²) lookups with Maps in UpcomingView and SearchModal
tasks.description: UpcomingView.isDone() (lines ~35-38) calls projects.find() then columns.find() for every rendered task, producing O(n²) work. SearchModal (lines ~96-98) repeats a columns.find() inside the match loop. Pre-build a Map<columnId, columnName> once per render so lookups are O(1).

tasks.title: Add useMemo to DoneView and ReportsView derived data
tasks.description: DoneView.projectsWithDone (lines ~18-31) iterates and filters projects/tasks on every render without memoization. ReportsView has similar patterns in projectTime and projectLoad (lines ~64-101). Wrapping these in useMemo avoids rebuilding the derived arrays when unrelated state changes trigger re-renders.

tasks.title: Memoize projectTasks and extract repeated column lookups in App.tsx
tasks.description: projectTasks is filtered on every App render (lines ~114-120) without useMemo. handleCompleteTask and handleRestoreTask (lines ~241-258) both do project.columns.find(name === 'done') and .sort() inline — these should share a memoized utility so string comparisons and sorts don't repeat on each call.

tasks.title: Harden toggleHabit for idempotency
tasks.description: toggleHabit in kanban.ts (lines ~561-571) mutates the completions array inside a filter, which can behave unexpectedly if called concurrently or replayed. Rewrite using an explicit Set-based dedup so calling toggleHabit twice with the same (habitId, date) is guaranteed to produce a stable, correct state regardless of call order.
